_comment: Alif SETOOLS ATOC template for the Alif Ensemble E8 DevKit OSPI flash layout.
_comment_addresses: TF-A bl32 lands at OSPI offset 0x00000000; DTB at the value of KERNEL_DTB_ADDR offset within OSPI (default 0x80010000 mapped to OSPI 0x00010000); xipImage at XIP_KERNEL_LOAD_ADDR offset (default 0x80020000 -> OSPI 0x00020000). Override at flash time via the wrapper script if a different OSPI base map is used.
